approved_manuscript_text_en: M3-CBI was prespecified, but its executed Data Gate remained unresolved because point-in-time availability could not be established. The block was therefore not admitted to modeling. Consequently, the M3-CBI−M2 comparison was not executed, no p-value was computed, and no inferential conclusion is drawn for M3-CBI. The M3-LAG-WDI analysis is reported separately as supplementary exploratory evidence and is neither a substitute nor a proxy for confirmatory M3-CBI.
approved_manuscript_text_fa: بلوک M3-CBI از پیش تعریف شده بود، اما Data Gate اجراشده آن به‌دلیل اثبات‌نشدن دسترسی point-in-time حل‌نشده باقی ماند؛ بنابراین این بلوک وارد مدل‌سازی نشد. در نتیجه، مقایسه M3-CBI−M2 اجرا نشد، هیچ مقدار p محاسبه نشد و هیچ نتیجه استنباطی درباره M3-CBI ارائه نمی‌شود. تحلیل M3-LAG-WDI به‌صورت جداگانه و صرفاً به‌عنوان شواهد اکتشافی تکمیلی گزارش می‌شود و جایگزین یا نماینده M3-CBI تأییدی نیست.
authorized_scope: Recording ONLY of the human decision to discontinue the M3-CBI block without admitting it to modeling, and of how its never-executed confirmatory comparison is reported. This authorization does NOT cover any data retrieval or download, any new contact or follow-up with the World Bank or any official source, re-executing the M3 Data Gate, computing any new coverage or threshold, materializing any M3-CBI feature, modeling, incremental evaluation, Holm execution, bootstrap, SHAP, prediction, final-model selection, paper-winner selection, full-development refit, Final Test access, Stage130, changing any existing PR, or marking this PR ready or merging it.
human_decision_translation: I agree that M3-CBI should be stopped, without entering modeling, because its Data Gate was not resolved and there is no provable point-in-time evidence. The M3_CBI-M2 comparison is kept as a prespecified but unexecuted comparison, with no p-value and no inferential conclusion. M3-LAG-WDI is reported only as a supplementary exploratory analysis and is not a substitute or proxy for M3-CBI. This decision does not authorize final-model selection, refit, Stage130 or Final Test access.
human_decision_verbatim: موافقم M3-CBI به علت حل‌نشدن Data Gate و نبود شواهد قابل‌اثبات point-in-time، بدون ورود به مدل‌سازی متوقف شود. مقایسه M3_CBI−M2 به‌عنوان مقایسه از پیش تعریف‌شده اما اجرا‌نشده، بدون p-value و بدون نتیجه استنباطی حفظ شود. M3-LAG-WDI صرفاً به‌عنوان تحلیل supplementary exploratory گزارش شود و جایگزین یا نماینده M3-CBI نباشد. این تصمیم مجوز انتخاب مدل نهایی، refit، Stage130 یا دسترسی به Final Test نیست.
stop_reason_summary: The M3 macro Data Gate WAS executed and terminated at UNRESOLVED_M3_DATA_GATE: the prospective definition lock stayed incomplete for all three candidates, no independently verifiable official CBI evidence was obtained, and G04 (published_at or available_at verified) was never satisfied, so point-in-time availability could not be established. The block was therefore stopped before admission and before any modeling.

superseded_marker.previous_value_meaning: The executed Gate terminated UNRESOLVED and handed the disposition question to a human. No human disposition had been recorded.
superseded_marker.resolved_value_meaning: The required human review has now taken place and its outcome is discontinuation. The Gate's own status is NOT reassigned and stays UNRESOLVED_M3_DATA_GATE.

why_not_recorded_as_fail_m3_data_gate: The Gate was executed and its locked vocabulary includes FAIL_M3_DATA_GATE, but the Gate did not return it. It terminated at UNRESOLVED_M3_DATA_GATE because the definition lock was incomplete and no independently verifiable official evidence existed — not because a candidate was assessed and failed a threshold. No value-level assessment was ever executed. Recording this as FAIL_M3_DATA_GATE would assert an evaluation outcome the Gate never produced.
why_not_recorded_as_gate_not_executed: The Gate WAS executed as action stage128-m3-macro-data-gate, its authorization was consumed, and it produced a terminal UNRESOLVED snapshot with 8 recorded unresolved/blocker reasons. Recording it as never executed would erase a completed research action.
